question: Which ancient Greek historian and diplomat is the author of the book '*Indica*'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Megasthenes.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Megasthenes was an ancient Greek historian, diplomat** and **Indian ethnographer and explorer** in the Hellenistic period.
 
• He described India in his book Indica.
 
• In the book, he records his impressions of I
